# Alex Velesnitski - extended profile

Last updated: 2026-10-22. Source of truth for dates and details: https://github.com/velesnitski/CV

## Summary

Alex Velesnitski is a CTO / Head of Engineering with 18+ years in software: backend and system architecture, infrastructure, and engineering leadership. He has led teams of 50+ engineers and built healthcare platforms, high-load VPN/ZTNA products serving 10M+ users, and open-source developer tooling around the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Roles

- Head of Engineering, cybersecurity (VPN/ZTNA) product company - current. Owns engineering end to end: mobile and desktop clients, backend, infrastructure and QA teams; security, compliance and cloud infrastructure.
- CTO, Timspark - software services company; technology strategy, delivery, AI services line.
- CTO, Intetics - software services company; AWS Advanced Services Partner accreditation; GSA Professional Awards 2022, Manager of the Year finalist.

## Tech focus

- Languages: Rust, Go, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node.js, Python, PHP
- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Traefik, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions
- Domains: VPN/ZTNA and network-filtering detection, healthcare, high-load systems, developer tooling (MCP servers), team analytics, code-quality automation, AI-assisted software engineering

## Open source (selected)

MCP servers
- gl-mcp (Rust): GitLab MCP server - code review, team analytics, spec-drift audits. https://github.com/velesnitski/gl-mcp
- yt-mcp (Python): YouTrack MCP server - issues, sprint boards, team dashboards. https://github.com/velesnitski/yt-mcp
- zbbx-mcp (Python): Zabbix MCP server - infrastructure monitoring, traffic analysis. https://github.com/velesnitski/zbbx-mcp
- slk-mcp (Go): Slack MCP server - digests, decision detection, voice transcription. https://github.com/velesnitski/slk-mcp

Tools and guides
- detect-blocking (Bash): diagnose what kind of network filtering blocks a VPN endpoint; 27 probes, baseline/diff, CI-tested. https://github.com/velesnitski/detect-blocking
- 529kit: local AI fallback kit (Ollama + Hermes + open-weights model) for cloud-model outages, drill-first. https://github.com/velesnitski/529kit
- claude-code-quickstart: Claude Code in 12 minutes. https://github.com/velesnitski/claude-code-quickstart
- rca-template: AI-assisted root cause analysis framework. https://github.com/velesnitski/rca-template
- Multi-agent templates for Claude Code: php-agents-boilerplate, nuxt-agents, wp-agents.
